title: agent_pass v1
description: Last fact of every collection pass. A collector whose records and snapshot did not change since it last sent them sends nothing; in_force names, for every such collector that ran in the pass and for those that sent their facts, the snapshot that holds now. The engine takes a snapshot older than its window as current when the newest agent_pass in the window names it. The agent sends every collector in full at least every 3 days.

in_force.description: One "fact:run_id" per collector: the snapshot fact and the pass that sent it.
